name: Smite
effect: Target one enemy within 35m and make a Psychic Mastery (Wil) Test against their Defence. If successful, the target suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds. Potency [3]: +1 Mortal Wound.

name: Chameleon
effect: While sustained, you gain +5 bonus dice to Stealth (A) Tests and +1 to your Defence against ranged attacks.

name: Compel
effect: Implant a simple command in the mind of a nearby creature within 5m. Target must pass DN 4 Willpower Test or is compelled to obey.

name: Invoke Luck
effect: For 1 Round, you may choose to gain +1 bonus dice to one Test you make.

name: Inflict Pain
effect: Target within 5m immediately takes 1d3 Shock and must make DN 3 Willpower Test or be Staggered. Sustained.

name: Conjure Flame
effect: Conjure a simple flame that can be used to ignite combustible materials or as a weapon dealing 8+1 ED damage.

name: Dull Pain
effect: Target within 5m reduces all Shock suffered by 1 while sustained.

name: Flash Bang
effect: Everyone within 5m must make DN 3 Toughness Test or take 1 Shock and be Blinded for 1 round.

name: Hover
effect: You can float freely, hovering or moving slowly up or down (1/2 Speed). Sustained.

name: Phantom Grip
effect: Manifest invisible phantom hands within 10m to perform tasks. Strength and Agility equal to your Willpower.

name: Mental Force
effect: Shove a target within 15m. Target must make DN 4 Agility Test or be knocked Prone.

name: Psychic Torch
effect: Conjure a floating orb of glowing light within 5m. Sustained.

name: Enfeeble
effect: Target within 10m has Strength reduced by 1 and suffers 1 Shock at the beginning of each turn while sustained.

name: Life Leech
effect: Target within 5m suffers 1d6 Shock and 1d3 Wounds. You heal half the amount inflicted.

name: Warp Speed
effect: Speed is doubled, take one additional Action per round, +1 Defence, act first every Round. Suffer 1d3+1 Shock per round sustained.

name: Regeneration
effect: While sustained, heal 1 Wound per Round (or 1 Shock if at max Wounds).

name: Forewarning
effect: Seize the Initiative once without spending Glory, gain +1 Defence for the combat.

name: Prescience
effect: Reroll 1 die (not Wrath) in any Tests for the scene. May ask one question about the future.

name: Misfortune
effect: Target within 30m becomes Vulnerable (1) and Hindered (1) while sustained.

name: Fiery Form
effect: Burst into flame. All creatures within 2m take 10+1 ED damage. +1 Defence, immune to FIRE/MELTA damage.

name: Flame Breath
effect: Spew a gout of warpfire in a 5m line with the Flamer Trait.

name: Molten Beam
effect: Release a beam traveling 10m. Targets suffer 18+2 ED damage and must pass DN 4 Initiative Test or be On Fire.

name: Spontaneous Combustion
effect: Targets within 20m suffer 12+1 ED damage and must make DN 4 Agility Test or be On Fire.

name: Assail
effect: Uproot a large object and smite enemies within 20m for 10+1 ED damage.

name: Crush
effect: Target within 20m takes 10+1 ED damage and must pass DN 5 Strength/Willpower or be Restrained. 10+1 ED each turn sustained.

name: Levitation
effect: Fly freely at normal Speed while sustained. Suffer 1 Shock per hour sustained.

name: Telekinetic Dome
effect: Gain +2 Resilience and may roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. 1 Shock per minute sustained.

name: Shock Wave
effect: All creatures within 5m take 12+1 ED damage and must pass DN 5 Agility Test or be Prone.

name: Telepathy
effect: Communicate mentally with targets within 100m. Can eavesdrop on surface thoughts.

name: Psychic Shriek
effect: Target within 50m takes 1d3+3 Shock and must pass DN 5 Willpower Test or be Staggered.

name: Terrify
effect: All enemies within 10m must make a DN 5 Fear Test.

name: Fog the Mind
effect: Enemies within 10m must pass DN 6 Willpower Test or be Hindered (2) and Staggered. 1 Shock per round sustained.

name: Mind Probe
effect: Win Opposed Willpower to probe target's mind within 30m. Ask one question per turn sustained.

name: Conceal / Reveal
effect: Conceal: +1 Defence and +1 Stealth for you and allies within 5m. Reveal: Enemies in Blast (6) can't benefit from cover.

name: Embolden / Horrify
effect: Embolden: +1 bonus die to Resolve for allies within 5m. Horrify: +1 DN to Resolve for enemies in Blast (6).

name: Empower / Enervate
effect: Empower: +1 ED to melee attacks for allies within 5m. Enervate: -1 ED to melee for enemies in Blast (6).

name: Enhance / Drain
effect: Enhance: +1 bonus die to Weapon Skill for allies within 5m. Drain: +1 DN to Weapon Skill for enemies in Blast (6).

name: Protect / Jinx
effect: Protect: +1 Resilience for allies within 5m. Jinx: -1 Resilience for enemies in Blast (6).

name: Quicken / Restrain
effect: Quicken: Additional Movement for allies within 5m. Restrain: Enemies in Blast (6) move as in Difficult Terrain.

name: Repair/Ruin
effect: Repair: Restore 2 Wounds to a piece of wraithbone or wraithbone construct. Ruin: Inflict 2 Wounds on a piece of wraithbone. Potency: [1] +1 Wound. [3] Inflict a Mortal Wound on a wraithbone construct.

name: Conjure Wraithbone
effect: Create a simple wraithbone shape. Shield: flat surface up to 3m diameter. Spear: up to 3m long. Spine: sharp spurs 1m high covering 10 square meters, area becomes Difficult Terrain. Potency: [1] +10m range or +1 sq meter. [3] Create additional piece.

name: Shape/Reshape
effect: Guide the shape of existing wraithbone. A Round: join pieces or simple shapes. A Scene: complex forms or armour plates. A Day: sophisticated shapes with moving parts. Affects up to 10 sq metres. Potency: [2] +5 sq metres. [3] Exceptional quality, -1 DN for further manipulations.

name: Fog of Dreams
effect: While sustained, you and allies with HARLEQUIN [MASQUE] Keyword gain +1 Defence and +1 bonus die to Stealth Tests. Potency: [3] +1 Defence and +1d Stealth. [2] Range increased to 30m.

name: Mirror of Minds
effect: Target suffers 12+1 ED damage and must pass DN 5 Willpower or Psychic Mastery Test or suffer 1d3 Mortal Wounds. Potency: [3] +2 ED damage. [2] Target must also make DN 3 Fear Test.

name: Shards of Light
effect: Polychrome shards travel 10m in a straight line. Targets suffer 12+2 ED damage and must pass DN 4 Willpower or Psychic Mastery Test or gain Blinded. Potency: [2] +1 DN, may also gain Prone. [1] +10m range.

name: Twilight Pathways
effect: Target ally with HARLEQUIN [MASQUE] Keyword may take one additional Action per Round while sustained. Potency: [1] Target acts first in every Round. [2] Target also gains +1 Defence.

name: Veil of Tears
effect: Characters with HARLEQUIN [MASQUE] Keyword within range gain +2 Defence and +2 bonus dice to Stealth Tests until next Turn. Potency: [3] Activation reduced to an Action. [2] Range increased to 30m.

name: Webway Dance
effect: While sustained, allies with HARLEQUIN [MASQUE] Keyword may reroll failed Determination rolls. Potency: [3] Allies may make additional Move Action. [2] +1 bonus die to Stealth Tests.

name: Doom
effect: While sustained, target suffers -1 Base Resilience and +1 DN to Resolve Tests. Potency: [3] Additional -1 Resilience. [2] Additional +1 DN to Resolve.

name: Executioner
effect: Summon a vengeful astral doppelganger. Target suffers 14+2 ED damage and must pass DN 3 Fear Test. Potency: [3] +2 ED damage. [2] +1 DN to Fear Test.

name: Fortune
effect: You and all AELDARI allies gain +1 Defence until next Turn. Potency: [2] Additional +1 Defence. [1] +1 Round duration.

name: Guide
effect: You and all AELDARI allies within range gain +2 bonus dice to Ballistic Skill Tests until next Turn. Potency: [2] Additional +2 bonus dice. [1] +10m range.

name: Mind War
effect: Make Opposed Willpower Test. If you succeed, target suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds. Potency: [2] +1 Mortal Wound. [1] Activation reduced to an Action.

name: Will of Asuryan
effect: While sustained, you and all AELDARI allies within range gain +2 Resilience and may roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Potency: [2] +1 Resilience. [1] +10m Range.

name: Crushing Orb
effect: Target gains Restrained and suffers 10+2 ED damage. Must pass DN 3 Strength or Psychic Mastery to escape; failure deals additional 10+2 ED per Round sustained. Potency: [2] +1 DN to escape. [1] +1 ED damage.

name: Fateful Divergence
effect: Any AELDARI within range may reroll one failed Determination roll until next Turn. Potency: [3] +2 bonus dice when rerolling. [2] +1 bonus dice when rerolling.

name: Focus Will
effect: Target gains +2 bonus dice to next Deny the Witch attempt. Potency: [2] Target also gains +1 to all Psychic Mastery Tests until next Turn.

name: Ghostwalk
effect: Target gains +3 Speed until next Turn. Potency: [2] Target may make additional Move Action this Turn. [1] +1 Speed.

name: Impair Senses
effect: Target gains Hindered (2) until next Turn. Potency: [3] Target must also make DN 3 Fear Test. [2] Target also gains Blinded.

name: Witchstrike
effect: Attacks made with a Witchblade gain +2 ED damage. Potency: [2] +1 Round duration. [1] +1 ED damage.
